faq_2_q: Do I have to change my current CRM?
faq_1_a: Your data is absolutely protected. We work exclusively with private enterprise APIs that strictly comply with GDPR and European regulations (zero retention). Your information is NEVER used to train public AI models.
faq_2_a: You don't have to change your workflow at all. We adapt to your current infrastructure and connect directly to your tools (CRM, ERP, web) via API, ensuring a smooth integration with no learning curve for your team.
faq_3_a: The development belongs 100% to you. Upon project completion, we hand over all source code, system architecture, and access credentials. You are the absolute owner of your tool, with no technical lock-ins or dependencies on any provider (Vendor Lock-in).
faq_4_a: There are no mandatory monthly fees for our software. Our model is a one-time payment for development. From then on, you only assume the direct cost at the provider's price for your own server or minimum API consumption (usually a few cents a month), with no hidden margins from us.

modal_legal_text: This website is strictly informational. Lanza Estudio offers B2B consulting, programming, and automation development services. As a static site, we do not conduct e-commerce or collect transaction data directly through this platform.
modal_privacy_text:
Zero Cookies, Zero Tracking.

At Lanza Estudio, we deeply respect your privacy. This website is completely static and does not install any cookies on your browser.

We do not use trackers, save IP addresses, or use Google Analytics, Facebook pixels, or similar tools.

If you decide to contact us via WhatsApp or Email links, the information you provide will be treated strictly confidentially and exclusively to manage your diagnostic request. We will never share your data with third parties or send you unsolicited advertising.
hero_why_1_desc: We are experts in SEO, Positioning, API integrations, Cloud architectures, AI development, and Bots. We build custom systems without relying on closed templates, mastering native code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, Python, C++, etc...).
hero_why_2_desc: Our goal is to make your business profitable, not just integrate AI because it's a trend. We analyze the most economical and scalable path. A real example: if external AI API consumption skyrockets your costs and you prefer manual oversight, we build a smart prompt generator (connected to your own database) so you can exploit monthly subscription models for a fraction of the price.
hero_why_3_desc: If you are starting from scratch with no volume, we build the digital infrastructure to create and capture that client portfolio from the first visit. And if you already manage a high business volume, we develop the necessary management tools to serve them as they deserve, optimize the service, and turn them into recurring clients.
